1.text: By the star when it descends,

2.text: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

3.text: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

4.text: It is not but a revelation revealed,

5.text: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -

6.text: One of soundness.<sup foot_note="227911">1</sup> And he rose to [his] true form<sup foot_note="227912">2</sup>

footnotes.227911: i.e., strength of body and of mind.
footnotes.227912: Gabriel appeared to Muḥammad (ﷺ) at the outset of his prophethood in the angelic form in which Allāh originally created him.

7.text: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.<sup foot_note="227913">1</sup>

footnotes.227913: - i.e., in the sky, above the eastern horizon.

9.text: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

10.text: And he revealed to His Servant<sup foot_note="227914">1</sup> what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].

footnotes.227914: - i.e., to the Servant of Allāh, Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

11.text: The heart<sup foot_note="227915">1</sup> did not lie [about] what it saw.

footnotes.227915: - i.e., mind or perception (of the Prophet [ﷺ]).

12.text: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

13.text: And he certainly saw him in another descent<sup foot_note="227916">1</sup>

footnotes.227916: - i.e., on another occasion.  During his ascent into the heavens (al-Miʿrāj), the Prophet (ﷺ) also saw Gabriel in his true form.

14.text: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

15.text: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -

16.text: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].<sup foot_note="227917">1</sup>

footnotes.227917: - Then and there he (ﷺ) saw Gabriel in angelic form.

17.text: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

18.text: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

19.text: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

20.text: And Manāt, the third - the other one?<sup foot_note="227918">1</sup>

footnotes.227918: - The three names given in this and the previous verse are those of well-known "goddesses" which were worshipped by the pagan Arabs before the spread of Islām.

21.text: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

22.text: That, then, is an unjust division.<sup foot_note="227919">1</sup>

23.text: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

24.text: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

25.text: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

26.text: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

27.text: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

28.text: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

29.text: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

30.text: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

31.text: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

32.text: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

33.text: Have you seen the one who turned away

34.text: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

35.text: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?<sup foot_note="227920">1</sup>

footnotes.227920: - Knows that his provision will be exhausted if he spends on the poor, while Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) has promised otherwise.

36.text: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

38.text: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

39.text: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

40.text: And that his effort is going to be seen -

41.text: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -

42.text: And that to your Lord is the finality

43.text: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

44.text: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

45.text: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

46.text: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

47.text: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.

48.text: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

49.text: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius<sup foot_note="227921">1</sup>

footnotes.227921: - A star worshipped by some of the pagan Arabs.

50.text: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad

51.text: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

52.text: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

53.text: And the overturned towns<sup foot_note="227922">1</sup> He hurled down

54.text: And covered them by that which He covered.<sup foot_note="227923">1</sup>

55.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

56.text: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.

58.text: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.

59.text: Then at this statement do you wonder?

60.text: And you laugh and do not weep

61.text: While you are proudly sporting?<sup foot_note="227924">1</sup>

footnotes.227924: - Additional meanings are "singing [with expanded chest]," "heedless," or "lost in vain amusements."

62.text: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].
